hero.headline_html:
When it breaks at
2am, we still answer.
hero.lede: Licensed plumbers and electricians on call around the clock. No overtime fees for nights or weekends — the quote we give you is the price you pay.
hero.emergency_note: Average dispatch time: 41 minutes, day or night.

services.heading: Plumbing and electrical, one call
services.sub: Every technician is cross-trained, so a single visit can cover both trades — no waiting on a second contractor.

items.name: Water heaters
items.desc: Repair, replacement, and tankless conversions. Most standard installs completed same day.

items.name: Drain & sewer
items.desc: Camera inspection, hydro-jetting, and trenchless repair for slow or backed-up lines.

items.name: Panel upgrades
items.desc: 100–200 amp service upgrades to keep up with modern appliances and EV chargers.

items.name: Lighting & wiring
items.desc: Fixture installs, rewiring for older homes, and troubleshooting for flickering circuits.

items.name: Leak detection
items.desc: Non-invasive detection for slab and wall leaks before they become drywall repairs.

items.name: Remodel rough-in
items.desc: Full plumbing and electrical rough-in for kitchen and bathroom remodels, on your GC's timeline.

process.heading: From call to fixed, same day

steps.title: Call or text
steps.desc: Tell us what's happening. We'll give you an upfront price range before anyone drives out.

steps.title: We diagnose on site
steps.desc: A licensed tech inspects the issue and gives you a flat-rate quote before any work starts.

steps.title: You approve, we fix
steps.desc: Nothing happens without your sign-off. Most jobs are completed in a single visit.

steps.title: Backed by warranty
steps.desc: Every repair carries a 2-year workmanship warranty, parts and labor.
